cluster_choice: Four exploratory local clusters fixed before responses; not selected as optimal or validated semantic themes.
query_language: Manually specified English retrieval equivalents shared by both methods; original Portuguese question used for generation.

questions.question: Quais problemas específicos são relatados, em quais condições e que experiências divergentes aparecem?
questions.retrieval_query: What specific problems with this hair diffuser are reported, under what usage conditions, and what contrasting experiences are described?

aspects.label: Encaixe e fixação
aspects.retrieval_query: User reports of hair diffuser fit problems, nozzle diameter, attachment security and contrasting dryer compatibility experiences.

aspects.label: Colapso durante o uso
aspects.retrieval_query: User reports of hair diffuser collapsing during drying, staying extended or needing reshaping during use.

aspects.label: Durabilidade e integridade
aspects.retrieval_query: User reports of hair diffuser breaking, separating parts, filter falling out, useful life and long lasting experiences.

aspects.label: Secagem, cachos e frizz
aspects.retrieval_query: User reports of hair diffuser drying time, curl definition and frizz, favorable and unfavorable results with hair type and usage conditions.

aspects.label: Portabilidade e armazenamento
aspects.retrieval_query: User reports of hair diffuser folding for travel and storage, benefits and practical difficulties.

questions.question: Que melhorias poderiam ser investigadas a partir desses problemas, quais qualidades deveriam ser preservadas e o que precisaria ser validado?
questions.retrieval_query: What hair diffuser improvements could be investigated from reported problems, which valued qualities should be preserved, and what needs validation?

aspects.label: Encaixe e fixação
aspects.retrieval_query: Hair diffuser attachment or fit problems and valued secure fit to preserve when investigating improvements.

aspects.label: Colapso durante o uso
aspects.retrieval_query: Hair diffuser collapsing during use, flexibility and folding benefits to preserve while investigating improvements.

aspects.label: Durabilidade e integridade
aspects.retrieval_query: Hair diffuser breakage, loose parts or filter, durability complaints and valued long lasting use.

aspects.label: Secagem, cachos e frizz
aspects.retrieval_query: Hair diffuser drying speed, curl definition and frizz complaints and valued performance to preserve.

aspects.label: Portabilidade e armazenamento
aspects.retrieval_query: Hair diffuser portability, compact storage and travel benefits, with reported limitations to investigate.

policy: One attempt per question/method, no automatic retry, translation or repair. Preserve previous rounds. Same corpus, index, local groups, aspect searches, context and model. Source text supplied by system is not semantic validation of the generated claim. Development-only.
changes: Generation only: Portuguese prompt and compact Portuguese schema, source ID instead of copied quote; original source materialized by application. Retrieval candidates and context order must exactly match round 2 per question/method.
